rules.title: How to play
rules.ways: 1024 ways: 5 reels × 4 rows. Matching symbols on adjacent reels from the leftmost reel pay, on any row. Wins are multiplied by the bet.
rules.ways@social: 1024 ways: 5 reels × 4 rows. Matching symbols on adjacent reels from the leftmost reel win, on any row. Wins are multiplied by the play amount.
rules.wild: WILD appears on reels 2 to 5 and substitutes for every symbol except SCATTER.
rules.scatter: SCATTER appears on any reel. 3 SCATTERS trigger NINE LIVES, 4 or more trigger DOUBLE GAZE.
rules.laser: LASER DOT: the cat's eyes fire a dot that hops across 3 to 8 cells. Each visited cell levels up one step (glyph → better glyph → premium). The top premium stays as it is. The dot never touches WILD or SCATTER and never creates a WILD. The last cell gets a multiplier from ×2 to ×10, applied to every way through that cell.
rules.chips: CHIPS (free spins): every visited cell keeps a chip until the end of the bonus. A symbol landing on a chip arrives levelled up by the chip level (+1 to +3, shown by its number of chevrons and its number). WILD and SCATTER ignore chips.
rules.nineLives: NINE LIVES: {n} free spins, one laser dot per spin. The lives are the spin counter.
rules.doubleGaze: DOUBLE GAZE: {n} free spins, two laser dots per spin (one per eye), chips placed at the start. When multipliers cross, the multiplier shown for each win is the one applied.
rules.retrigger: During free spins, {s} SCATTERS add {n} free spins.
rules.feature.scan: SCAN: one spin with one guaranteed laser dot. Price: {x} × bet.
rules.feature.doubleScan: DOUBLE SCAN: one spin with two laser dots. Price: {x} × bet.
rules.feature.scan@social: SCAN: one spin with one guaranteed laser dot. Cost: {x} × play amount.
rules.feature.doubleScan@social: DOUBLE SCAN: one spin with two laser dots. Cost: {x} × play amount.
rules.ante: ANTE: more SCATTERS (×{s} chance). Each spin costs {x} × bet while Ante is on. It is not a purchase.
rules.ante@social: ANTE: more SCATTERS (×{s} chance). Each spin costs {x} × play amount while Ante is on.
rules.maxWin: Maximum win: {x} × bet. When it is reached, the round ends and the win is paid.
rules.maxWin@social: Maximum win: {x} × play amount. When it is reached, the round ends.
rules.tiers: Big win celebrations start from ×10 the bet on a single spin.
rules.tiers@social: Big win celebrations start from ×10 the play amount on a single spin.
rules.controls: Space or Enter: spin. During a spin, a second press stops the reels quickly without changing the result.
rules.malfunction: Malfunction voids all pays and plays.
rules.malfunction@social: Malfunction voids all wins and plays.
